name: inverted shrug (on parallel bars)
description: Hanging from parallel bars, you shrug your shoulder blades up and down. It builds the traps and shoulder control.
instructions: Grip the parallel bars and hang in an inverted position with arms straight.
Keep your body stable and your elbows locked.
Draw your shoulder blades down and together, pulling your body up a little.
Lower back to a full hang under control.
